request.subject: UNIT:GOBLIN:MARKSMAN

layers.text: Change only his skin colour: the face, ears, chest, belly, arms and legs become a much lighter, medium true goblin green like moss, with a darker green shadow tone, so the face is clearly visible; not black, not yellow. Keep everything else the same: the rusted pot helmet and goggles, the orange-brown leather straps and loincloth, the bomb with its yellow stripes and spark, the satchel, pose, proportions, thick black outline and art style, on a transparent background.
